title: Capability Factsheet
description: Structured research output from the Researcher agent — one per catalog entry

slug.description: URL-safe identifier matching the catalog entry (lowercase, hyphens)

what_it_is.description: 1-2 sentences: what the tool is and its primary purpose

components.description: Major components or services the tool provides

protocols.description: Protocols the tool speaks or implements

measurement.description: Observable metrics, KPIs, or measurement capabilities

configuration.description: What can be tuned or configured

fault_injection.description: Impairments or fault scenarios possible (empty if none)

constraints.description: Hard limitations — what the tool cannot do

docker_services.description: Services from docker-compose (empty if no compose file)

notable_absences.description: What the tool explicitly does NOT include
